_comment: Per-artifact char ceilings. A new feature that pushes a build over its ceiling has to earn it — raise the number deliberately, in the same commit, and say why. That friction is the anti-bloat gate. These ration attention, not context window or cost: every artifact here is well under 1% of a frontier context window, so the numbers do NOT move when windows grow. Keep ~5% headroom — a ceiling a build already sits flush against (koan-wrap was at 6098/6100) stops being a budget and becomes a wall that blocks the next edit. The ratchet turns BOTH ways: after an ablation, lower every ceiling back to the new size + ~5%, or the freed space silently becomes budget for the next feature (2026-08-05).
